correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, a label-1 vertex would require a positive adjacent defender, which violates independent positive support. Every positive support is therefore an independent dominating set. The nested half-graph neighborhoods force a unique cut S_t, t=0,...,n; endpoint cuts have exactly one forced label 3 and each interior cut exactly two. All other supported vertices independently receive 2 or 3. Summing the resulting weight generating functions gives 2z^(2n+1)(1+z)^(n-1)+(n-1)z^(2n+2)(1+z)^(n-2); lower coefficient 2 is rigorous. Independent direct Python enumeration of all 4^(2n) labelings for n=2,3,4,5 matched entire feasible-support patterns and polynomial histograms. This finite check corroborates the all-n proof; no extrapolation.
